description: Combine the direct cuSOLVER BF16x9 path and its persistent fused-prep buffers with the validated warp/CTA small-matrix kernels, dispatching custom n=32 through n=128 and library factorization above that while tuning the crossover and shared cache behavior.

Combined the validated grouped-warp n=32, resident CTA n=64, and four-thread-row n=128 kernels with persistent per-input output buffers and the BF16x9 cuSOLVER path for n>=256; all tests and guards passed. Small cells measured 40.805/67.658/125.886 us and full-grid geomean reached 1474.633 us versus parent 1597.563 us.

Changed n=32 shared-memory grouping from eight warps per CTA to one warp per CTA while preserving persistent outputs and the n=64/128 plus cuSOLVER dispatch; validation passed. n=32 fell from 40.805 to 37.646 us, n=64/128 measured 67.387/125.456 us, and full geomean measured 1459.370 us.

Tested a four-warp n=32 CTA grouping between the one-warp and eight-warp variants; validation passed. n=32 measured 37.423 us versus 37.646 us for one-warp and 40.805 us for eight-warp grouping; n=64/128 were 67.015/125.286 us and full geomean measured 1457.063 us.

Tested two n=32 matrices per CTA; build and validation passed. n=32 measured 37.964 us versus 37.423 us for four-warps and 37.646 us for one-warp, while the unchanged n=256 cell sampled at 288.944 us; full-grid geomean measured 1481.726 us.

Restored the four-warp n=32 grouping and cached BF16x9 math-mode setup once per thread-local cuSOLVER handle, avoiding SetMathMode on every library call; validation passed. Small cells were 37.715/67.424/125.833 us and full geomean measured 1463.610 us versus 1457.063 for repeated setup in the prior four-warp sample.

Best measured commit c628c24 reached 1457.063 us, 8.80% below the 1597.563 us cuSOLVER parent and 32.34% below the 2153.690 us baseline, with all official tests and fresh-seed guards passing. The initial combined persistent-output dispatch (custom n=32/64/128, BF16x9 cuSOLVER n>=256) measured 1474.633 us with small cells 40.805/67.658/125.886 us. The n=32 CTA grouping sweep measured: eight warps 40.805 us, one warp 37.646 us (1459.370 aggregate), four warps 37.423 us (best 1457.063 aggregate), and two warps 37.964 us (1481.726 aggregate amid slower unchanged library cells). Restoring four warps while caching cuSOLVER math-mode setup once per handle measured 37.715/67.424/125.833 us and 1463.610 aggregate, showing repeated setup was small relative to Modal variation. Keep this line moving: remeasure c628c24 to separate its grouping gain from large-cell variance, test 16-warp n=32 grouping, sweep the n=128 custom/library crossover by batch, and explore pipelined-barrier or persistent multi-matrix n=128 variants. A fresh combine with the same-run mixed-precision large-shape path also remains open. Local profiling was waived by layout.
